title: Song - Amazing Grace
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: A pentatonic tune in 3/4 with a one-beat pickup over block chords (G, C, D) in the left, one chord per bar.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1283-new-britain: New Britain (the "Amazing Grace" hymn tune), SATB; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1283)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (tune: Virginia Harmony, 1831; harmonization: E. O. Excell, 1900) (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1283), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
